environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in private subnet, fronted by a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TLS termination. Security group allows inbound 443 from 10.0.0.0/8. No application-layer inspection is performed by the NLB. Instance has IAM role with S3 read access and runs with default file system permissions. The /etc/passwd and instance metadata service (169.254.169.254) are accessible from the application process.

config.network: private subnet with NAT gateway for outbound
